versions.content: The LIN Interface shall translate the error code reported by LinIf_LinErrorIndication to an error code of Lin_StatusType before calling Mirror_ReportLinFrame(). The error code LIN_ERR_RESP_STOPBIT shall be mapped LIN_TX_ERROR or LIN _RX_ERROR, depending on the direction of the current frame. The error codes LIN_ERR_RESP_CHKSUM and LIN_ERR_INCOMP_RESP shall be mapped to LIN_RX_ERROR. The error code LIN_ERR_NO_RESP shall be mapped to LIN_RX_NO_RESPONSE. The error code LIN_ERR_RESP_DATAB IT shall be mapped to LIN_TX_ERROR.
